name: plain-language
description: A first-party output policy that makes human-readable agent prose easy to find, understand, and use without weakening evidence, uncertainty, safety, precision, schemas, quotations, or requested voice.

interface.shortDescription: Reader-centered output without loss of evidence or precision.
interface.longDescription: Plain Language applies reader-centered guidance to human-readable agent output while preserving facts, evidence state, uncertainty, attribution, safety, accessibility, technical precision, required schemas, exact quotations, code, commands, and approved operator-voice content.
defaultPrompt: Apply Plain Language while preserving evidence, precision, schemas, and approved voice.
